QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_28

question.text: Kaplan-Schoar Public Market Equivalent (KS-PME) is used for:

answer.text: Benchmarking Cat I/II AIF performance against a listed market index by compounding cash flows at market returns
Calculating GST payable on management fees

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 244-246 describe KS-PME as a measure of Cat I/II AIF performance relative to the listed market, using market index returns as the compounding factor on capital calls and distributions. A KS-PME greater than 1 indicates the AIF outperformed the market benchmark. The Trap: Options B, C and D are unrelated to performance benchmarking. Note: Benchmark-selection nuances on pages 206 and 244-246 indicate that the PPM should name the benchmark and methodology, with the benchmark chosen to match the fund's investment style.
